scope: Real consented PNG OCR, image-only PDF OCR and synthetic English PCM WAV transcription through the local application
model_observation: Reported by application health; ImportPreview does not include a separate provider model-version field.

privacy_and_method.guard: A temporary in-page fetch wrapper inspected the actual FormData/File, verified its SHA-256 and consent, blocked other mutation/AI requests from the test page, then forwarded the original request to native fetch without changing the payload or response.
privacy_and_method.browser_interaction: Shared VS Code embedded browser, using native DOM activation for controls and Playwright file selection. This is not physical pointer or mobile-device acceptance.
privacy_and_method.timings: Observed client intervals include request guarding, submission and response decoding; they are not capacity or isolated-provider latency benchmarks.

fixture_sources.ocr_text:
DOCUMENT DE TEST SYNTHETIQUE
Commande OCR-2042 : 3 articles.
Livraison à Yaoundé.
Ne pas expédier avant mardi.

image.generator: Existing Pillow dependency with installed Arial, 44-pixel text on a white RGB image; every text bounding box checked for clipping.

scanned_pdf.generator: The same raster image exported by Pillow at 150 dpi and quality 95.

audio.generator: Installed offline Windows System.Speech synthesis, output to file only.
audio.source_text: This is a synthetic test. Order number 2042 contains three items. Do not ship it before Tuesday.

returned_warnings: AI transcription/OCR can omit or mishear words, especially in Cameroon Pidgin and Francanglais. Review against the source; it is not a manual fieldwork transcript.
The file was sent inline to Gemini for this request. This app does not retain it; provider data policies still apply.

quality_notes: OCR inserted blank lines between the four source lines. Whitespace-normalized text matches exactly; byte-for-byte layout preservation is not claimed.
The PDF was confirmed to have no extracted text layer before upload, so its successful result exercises cloud OCR rather than local text-layer extraction.
The WAV transcript exactly matches the text supplied to local synthesis, including the order number, quantity and no-shipment-before-Tuesday constraint.
All outputs were displayed as unreviewed AI transcripts with source/provider warnings, complete editable passages and explicit draft handoff controls.
instrumentation_issues_not_counted_as_pr: The initial inspector-based multipart guard blocked an upload before the server; a subsequent diagnostic was intentionally blocked as well. Neither yielded an application OCR response.
The diagnostic browser-tool script reported clearTimeout is not defined in its outer execution environment. Its remaining owned route was explicitly removed.

Re-selecting the identical file did not reset consent because it was not a file change. Clearing the owned picker first restored the empty, unchecked baseline. Switching to genuinely different PDF/WAV files subsequently reset consent and preview correctly.
Successful checks validated native FormData/File bytes inside the page instead of relying on the inspector's multipart representation. No application code or validation was bypassed.
limitations: Three representative synthetic files do not certify every file format, codec, document layout, multi-page scan, handwriting or noisy/long recording.
The speech clip was generated locally, not recorded from a physical microphone. Real Francanglais/Pidgin accents and transcription quality still need competent human review.
Video transcription, other audio codecs and every browser/device were not exercised in this live check.
The remaining structured-translation directions and complete native speech-to-AI-translation-to-audible-result flow were not rerun here.
These checks do not certify provider capacity, production VPS networking/storage, policies or public deployment.
No new production build, full test suite or documentation PDF rebuild was needed or claimed for these evidence-only media checks.
